question_text: Compare using a provider-managed online document editor as SaaS with running an organization’s own client-server document application. Explain two differences in management or resource availability.
adaptation_rationale: Cloud may itself use client-server; compare concrete management models, not false mutually exclusive categories. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: In SaaS, the provider manages application infrastructure/updates; the organization’s own deployment requires its staff to maintain servers/software. Provider capacity may be available on demand through the service, where local capacity depends on provisioned hardware. Both can use client-server communication.

marking_points.criterion: Provider service may offer on-demand resource capacity.
Contrasts local provisioned capacity without claiming cloud is not client-server.
